---
title: "Unsupported constructs"
format:
  emiljs:
    keep-emiljs: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      # each unsupported construct degrades with a single warning and never leaks
      noErrors: []
      printsMessage:
        - level: INFO
          regex: 'speaker notes are not supported'
        - level: INFO
          regex: 'footnotes are not supported'
        - level: INFO
          regex: 'tabsets are not supported'
        - level: INFO
          regex: 'callout options `appearance`, `icon` and `collapse` are ignored'
        - level: INFO
          regex: 'code line numbers are not supported'
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['h2']
        - ['div.panel-tabset', 'aside']
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        - selectors: ['section.slide']
          matches: ['Tab A', 'Tab B']
          noMatches: ['Secret', 'Footnote text']
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        - ['A footnote\.\n']
        - ['Secret', '\[\^1\]', 'Footnote text', 'panel-tabset', '\.notes']
---

Text.

::: {.notes}
Secret speaker notes.
:::

A footnote.[^1]

[^1]: Footnote text.

::: {.panel-tabset}
## Tab A
a

## Tab B
b
:::

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple" collapse="true"}
## Careful
Mind the gap.
:::

```{.python code-line-numbers="true"}
print(1)
```
